answer_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.location_code <> -1 AND s.country_code = 'DE' THEN f.net_amount END) / SUM(f.net_amount),
    2
  ) AS pct_of_total_net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS f
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
  ON f.store_key = s.store_key

body.value: 6.57 percent — the share of every dollar Contoso ever charged customers, after discount, that was taken at shops standing in Germany: 14,382,768.44 USD of 218,814,471.66 USD, across all sales on record from 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31. One figure, the whole ten-year history, no period or status narrowing. WHAT IT LEAVES OUT AND LETS IN: the top is the ten German physical shops only, so the web shop is absent from it, while the bottom INCLUDES the web shop's 86,790,054.13 — two fifths of all revenue, attributable to no country since its row carries the '--' sentinel. That is why the figure is 6.57 and not 10.89, which is what the same German revenue is worth measured against shop trade alone (132,024,417.53). Also outside the top: sales to German CUSTOMERS made elsewhere or online, which would make German-buyer revenue 24,638,830.18; inside it: 468,297.12 from the 2 German shops that have since closed. Gross revenue, before discount, is a different and larger measure and was not used anywhere in this ratio.

value.asks: What percentage of total net revenue
value.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.location_code <> -1 AND s.country_code = 'DE' THEN f.net_amount END) / SUM(f.net_amount),
    2
  ) AS pct_of_total_net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS f
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
  ON f.store_key = s.store_key
value.means: 6.57 percent — the share of every dollar Contoso ever charged customers, after discount, that was taken at shops standing in Germany: 14,382,768.44 USD of 218,814,471.66 USD, across all sales on record from 2016-05-18 to 2025-12-31. One figure, the whole ten-year history, no period or status narrowing. WHAT IT LEAVES OUT AND LETS IN: the top is the ten German physical shops only, so the web shop is absent from it, while the bottom INCLUDES the web shop's 86,790,054.13 — two fifths of all revenue, attributable to no country since its row carries the '--' sentinel. That is why the figure is 6.57 and not 10.89, which is what the same German revenue is worth measured against shop trade alone (132,024,417.53). Also outside the top: sales to German CUSTOMERS made elsewhere or online, which would make German-buyer revenue 24,638,830.18; inside it: 468,297.12 from the 2 German shops that have since closed. Gross revenue, before discount, is a different and larger measure and was not used anywhere in this ratio.

  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_revenue,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.location_code <> -1 AND s.country_code = 'DE' THEN f.net_amount END) / SUM(f.net_amount),
    2
  ) AS pct_of_total_net_revenue,
  ROUND(

    2
  ) AS pct_if_shops_only_denominator,
  MIN(f.order_date) AS first_order,
  MAX(f.order_date) AS last_order
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS f
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
  ON f.store_key = s.store_key
